content.title: Level 3 Site Walkthrough – 21 October 2026
content.summary: Anurag conducted a walkthrough of Level 3 with Sarah from Apex Concrete on 21 October 2026. The Zone B slab pour has been pushed to Thursday due to rain, and a blocked fire exit corridor on Level 1 and a missing handrail on Level 2 were identified and require immediate attention. Electrical rough-in on Level 3 is progressing at approximately 80% completion.

sections.heading: Site & areas inspected
points: Level 1 and Level 2 areas also noted during inspection.

sections.heading: Progress observed
points: Zone B slab pour delayed to Thursday due to rain; pump booking to be confirmed by Sarah by tomorrow 10:00 am.
Formwork Zone C in good condition.
Electrical rough-in approximately 80% complete on Level 3.

sections.heading: Defects / issues
points: Level 2 east stair landing: permanent handrail missing; temporary barricade currently in place.
Level 1 fire exit corridor: 2 pallets of blocks obstructing the exit.

sections.heading: Safety observations
points: Level 2 east stair landing – handrail absent; temp barricade installed as interim measure. Dave (foreman) instructed to rectify.
Level 1 fire exit corridor – 2 pallets of blocks blocking egress route; labourers directed to relocate today.

sections.heading: Instructions given
points: Dave (foreman) instructed to install permanent handrail at Level 2 east stair landing.
Labourers directed to clear pallet obstruction from Level 1 fire exit corridor today.
Sarah (Apex Concrete) to confirm pump booking by tomorrow 10:00 am.

action_items.task: Confirm pump booking for Zone B slab pour
Install permanent handrail at Level 2 east stair landing
Remove 2 pallets of blocks obstructing fire exit corridor on Level 1

decisions: Zone B slab pour rescheduled to Thursday due to rain.
follow_ups: Verify handrail installation at Level 2 east stair landing is completed and compliant.
Confirm Level 1 fire exit corridor is clear before end of day.
Confirm Sarah's pump booking once received.
Check electrical rough-in progress on Level 3 to confirm completion timeline.

flags.text: Level 1 fire exit corridor blocked by 2 pallets of blocks – potential WHS non-compliance and egress hazard. Responsible person: labourers/Dave (foreman). Verify cleared today.
Level 2 east stair landing: permanent handrail missing – fall hazard. Temp barricade in place. Dave (foreman) instructed to rectify. Confirm completion and compliance.

content.title: Website Launch Date and Budget Discussion
content.summary: A brief meeting between three attendees confirmed the website launch date has moved from the 28th to 4 November 2026. The Google Ads spend will be paused until launch. Priya is to notify the client by end of day.

sections.heading: Agenda items discussed
points: Website launch: development requires one more week; launch date moved from the 28th to the 4th.
Client communication: Priya to email client today to advise of the updated launch date.
Google Ads budget: pausing spend until the website launches to manage tight budget.

action_items.task: Email client to notify them of revised launch date (4th instead of 28th)
Pause Google Ads campaign until website launch

decisions: Website launch date confirmed as the 4th (moved from the 28th).
Google Ads to be paused until after launch due to budget constraints.
follow_ups: Confirm client has acknowledged the updated launch date following Priya's email.
Verify development is on track to meet the 4th deadline after one week of work.
